Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was
struck from the side while the patient was turning left. Complaints were of neck pain
with stiffness and low back pain with muscle tightness. The reported mechanism of
injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact described. Examination
revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness in the
lumbar region, supporting the reported strain. Other testing, including neurological
screening and straight leg raise, was within normal limits. No prior injury to the
cervical or lumbar spine is known to this provider. Conservative management consisted
of over-the-counter analgesics, gentle range-of-motion exercises, and a home
stretching program. Care followed a typical course, with symptoms steadily improving
and visit frequency tapering off after the second visit. Billed services reflect the
two visits provided, with no duplicate charges. Prognosis is good with continued home
exercise. Patient may return as needed if symptoms recur.
